newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grants free-mkt soft wheat, barley with refunds.
newsitem.headline: EU grants free-mkt soft wheat, barley with refunds.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday granted licences to export 237,470 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a maximum refund of 4.97 Ecus per tonne through its main tender programme, grain traders said.
It also awarded licences to export 46,000 tonnes of free-market barley at a maximum refund of 24.99 Ecus per tonne, they said.

In a separate tender the EU's cereals management committee also agreed the export of 13,500 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a maximum refund of 8.25 Ecus per tonne to African, Caribbean and Pacific countries, they said.
